result:
I've written the plan for w144 and the result file is set to `DONE`. w144 has no scenario, so its review is the only check. Requirement r40 asks that every spec round add one line to the initiative's ledger with `work note`.

**What changes:**
- **The round's instructions** (`agents/initiative-round.md`): the round's ledger line moves from a scratch file that was never committed to `.shop/work/<initiative>/ledger.md`, written with `work note`.
- **The round's tools** (`scripts/supervise_worker.py`): rounds started by `work run` may run `work note`, but no other `work` subcommand. Today they can't run `work` at all, so even a corrected instruction would have been refused.
- **The two skills** (`integrating-a-proposal`, `formulating-features`): when they start a round, they now give it the initiative's name. Their notes for the round say it ends with the ledger line. The researcher had left these two files out, but the work-item names them and `work note` needs the name.

**Decisions taken:**
- **Where the name comes from:** rounds started by `work run` read it from the proposal path already in their brief, so `supervise_brief.py` doesn't change.
- **Separate commit:** the ledger line is its own commit after the round's own work, so the `apply` round still commits only `spec/` (r6).
- **One line:** the round collapses its summary to a single line, because `work note` refuses line breaks.

No existing test breaks; I checked this by searching the tests, and no test checks the old ledger path or the rounds' tool lists. I left out `.shop/delivery.toml` because it doesn't exist in this repository.

**Open cases left for the implementer:**
- what a round does when its input gives no initiative name;
- what it does when `work note` refuses the line;
- whether a round that stops as `BLOCKED` still writes a line;
- the researcher found that `work note` accepts empty text. That's outside w144, so the implementer may only report it.

Files are in `.shop/scratch/2-plan/`:
- plan.md
- result.json
